_comment: drush-mcp (@bloomidea/drush-mcp): Node sidecar that shells out to Drush; no Drupal module required. NO read-only mode: drupal_drush, drupal_php_eval, drupal_sql_query are shell-equivalent. Use only for LOCAL/DISPOSABLE sites. DRUSH_CMD examples: 'ddev drush', 'lando drush', 'vendor/bin/drush'.
